[center][size=4][b]・・・۶ৎ・・・ Installation instructions ・・・۶ৎ・・・
[/b][/size][/center]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]This mod doesn't require anything complicated, download - unzip file - copy the folder into your Stardew Valley Mods folder. [/color][/size]

[center][color=#D4D4D8][b]₊˚ ✧ ━━━━⊱⋆⊰━━━━ ✧ ₊˚[/b] [/color][/center]

[center][size=4][b]・・・۶ৎ・・・ Main features (Update) ・・・۶ৎ・・・
[/b][/size][/center]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]You will be able to get each item from Robin's catalogue. Each item used to be sold separately in her shop, now there's less clutter.[/color][/size]

[b][font=Arial Black]TIPS[/font][/b]: I know know updating mods can be a bit messy, if you had the previous version, the items will show as error, just pick them up and delete them, then you can replace them with the new ones.

[b][font=Arial Black]Good to know[/font][/b]: I know Robin's catalogue can be quite expensive, but you don't have to wait to get the items on this set.
All you have to do is open the game, start your current save and if you don't have access to the catalogue yet, once the game is running, go to your SMAPI window and paste these following lines (you can do one by one to check what you're getting), then press enter. It will place the items directly inside your inventory right away:

player_add (F)AutumnMaeve.SoftBohoFurniture_BohoRosePainting
player_add (F)AutumnMaeve.SoftBohoFurniture_BohoCrochetDecor
player_add (F)AutumnMaeve.SoftBohoFurniture_BohoHangingPlant
player_add (F)AutumnMaeve.SoftBohoFurniture_BohoDecorChair
player_add (F)AutumnMaeve.SoftBohoFurniture_BohoDresser
player_add (F)AutumnMaeve.SoftBohoFurniture_BohoDecorBench
player_add (F)AutumnMaeve.SoftBohoFurniture_BohoRosieCouch
player_add (F)AutumnMaeve.SoftBohoFurniture_BohoCoffeeTable
player_add (F)AutumnMaeve.SoftBohoFurniture_BohoNightstand
player_add (F)AutumnMaeve.SoftBohoFurniture_BohoNightstand2
player_add (F)AutumnMaeve.SoftBohoFurniture_BohoNightstandLight
player_add (F)AutumnMaeve.SoftBohoFurniture_BohoRoundVase
player_add (F)AutumnMaeve.SoftBohoFurniture_BohoLargeVase
player_add (F)AutumnMaeve.SoftBohoFurniture_BohoSmallRug
player_add (F)AutumnMaeve.SoftBohoFurniture_BohoMediumRug
player_add (F)AutumnMaeve.SoftBohoFurniture_BohoLysRug
player_add (F)AutumnMaeve.SoftBohoFurniture_BohoLargeBed
player_add (F)AutumnMaeve.SoftBohoFurniture_BohoBed
